clips.title: The story
paras: Scourge loyal to Thule Ravenclaw gather in the hills southwest of Ambermill, threatening the Forsaken.

At Beren's Peril, a cave and mountain path lie high in the crags southwest of Ambermill, hidden from the main road. After the Third War, rogue Scourge undead fortified the refuge under the renegade necromancer Thule Ravenclaw. They refused to bow to the Dark Lady or flee north. Ravenclaw's regents, guardians, and drudgers gathered in secret to prepare an assault on the Forsaken base at the Sepulcher. Forsaken scouts uncovered them, and the quiet cliffs became a warzone. Horde fighters now move against the undead before they can attack.
